title: Meta blocks a feminist theatre ad while violent content stays up
teaser: Meta blocked a Barcelona theatre’s paid promotion for a feminist play on Instagram and Facebook after its automated system classified feminism and civil rights as “social topics.” The same platforms left up posts supporting an anti-Arab march, including calls for violence, and retained most AI-generated videos depicting brutal violence against children. The contrast exposes a moderation system that can treat advocacy as a policy violation while allowing far more dangerous material to circulate.
